csv_project_name: Engineering for Polly Ann Trail Modernization & Safety Impr
csv_agency: State of Michigan Department of Natural Resources
csv_scope_of_work: The Michigan Department of Natural Resources (DNR) invites qualified professional companies to submit a proposal for a one-time contract for Preliminary Engineering Services associated with completing a set of construction documents for two sections of the Polly Ann Trail (PAT) and meet current State and Federal shared-use path standards: 1) Oakland County Section - will modernize, reconstruct and make safety improvements to the existing trailway; 2) Lapeer County Section will require design and specifications for new trailway development. The project limits are approximately 37 miles: The PAT-Oakland is approximately 16.9 miles from Joslyn Road to Bordman Road within the communities of Orion Township, Oxford Township, Village of Oxford, Addison Township and the Village of Leonard. The PAT-Lapeer is approximately 20 miles from Bordman Road to Curtis Road within the communities of Dryden Township, Village of Dryden, Imlay Township, Imlay City, Attica Township, and Arcadia Township.

title: Engineering for Polly Ann Trail Modernization & Safety Improvements
short_description: Preliminary engineering for modernization and new development of a 37-mile shared-use trail.
project_location: Oakland County and Lapeer County, Michigan, USA
project_scope: Preliminary engineering services to prepare construction documents for two sections of the Polly Ann Trail totaling approximately 37 miles. The Oakland County section is about 16.9 miles from Joslyn Road to Bordman Road and includes modernization, reconstruction, and safety improvements to the existing trailway through Orion Township, Oxford Township, Village of Oxford, Addison Township, and Village of Leonard. The Lapeer County section is about 20 miles from Bordman Road to Curtis Road and requires design and specifications for new trailway development through Dryden Township, Village of Dryden, Imlay Township, Imlay City, Attica Township, and Arcadia Township. The trail is to meet current State and Federal shared-use path standards.
services: Preliminary engineering services and preparation of construction documents for trail modernization, reconstruction, safety improvements, and new shared-use path development.
relevance_explanation:
- Shared-use trail project, not a bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Scope is primarily civil/pathway design rather than structurally demanding engineering.
- No indication of bridges, long spans, lightweight structures, or innovative structural systems.
- Planning component exists, but it does not align closely with sbp's core focus areas.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information for a rough estimate: approximately 37 miles of shared-use trail, including 16.9 miles of modernization/reconstruction and safety improvements plus 20 miles of new trail development to current State and Federal standards.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The tender is for preliminary engineering services and construction documents for approximately 37 miles of trail works, but no budget, fee basis, or percentage is provided.
references_qualifications: Qualified professional companies are invited; specific reference or qualification requirements are not stated in the source excerpt.
contracting_authority: State of Michigan Department of Natural Resources, Agency ID 33415. Contact: Kurt Maiberger, Phone: 989-732-3541, Email: maibergerk@michigan.gov, Website: https://sigma.michigan.gov/PRDVSS1X1/Advantage4
notes: Project #: 864032. Target market: Parks. Mandatory pre-submittal meeting on 05/26/2026 at 10:30 AM EDT at 300 Dunlap Rd, Oxford, MI 48371-6900, USA. Questions deadline: 06/04/2026 02:00 PM EDT. Funding: MNRTF. Prevailing wage rates may apply. Solicitation documents available online.
